description: This file defines a PHP model class 'KpiSummaryModel' used for serializing KPI summary data related to performance reviews. It implements the 'Normalizable' interface and utilizes traits for serialization, and constructs itself based on a 'ReviewerRating' entity, mapping specific entity properties to serialization attributes.

classes.name: KpiSummaryModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes KPI summary data from a reviewer rating entity for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a ReviewerRating entity, setting entity, filters, and attribute names for serialization.
